Subject: Post-call: Security & compliance discovery - FinCo

Hi Alex — great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and immediate next steps from our side: 

- Current state: You mentioned FinCo is evaluating inference providers for customer-facing financial workflows (low-latency requirements). Security priorities are SOC 2 evidence, GDPR data handling, and potential HIPAA scope for a new product line.
- SOC 2: You said the primary ask is to see a SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) and to understand scope (infra only vs. app/data).
- Questionnaires: You preferred we start with your vendor security questionnaire to reduce back-and-forth.
- Timeline: Internal procurement wants initial answers by end of next week (July 30).

Agreed next steps:
1) We'll send the vendor security questionnaire you shared and fill initial responses (action: Rishi)
2) We'll provide our most recent SOC 2 report and a short compliance roadmap outlining ISO 27001 and FedRAMP plans (action: Marissa)
3) Follow-up call if any deep-dive required on controls (suggested week of Aug 2).

I'm looping Marissa and Rishi on the logistics. Marissa — can you confirm where we host SOC2 report and whether we can share the 2025 Type II PDF? Rishi — can you start a first pass on the questionnaire and flag any questions that need legal/security review?

Thanks,

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the recap. A couple clarifying items from FinCo's side: 

- Vendor questionnaire: Sending our standard security questionnaire in a separate email (Sara will include). Prefer the completed XLSX back; redlines are fine.
- SOC 2: We require the latest SOC 2 Type II report where possible. If Type II isn't available, please provide Type I + control matrix and a roadmap to Type II.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We will need details on data residency and processing for EU customers (GDPR). For HIPAA, can you confirm whether Redwood accepts ePHI under a BAA? If not, outline which features would need changes.

Can you (1) send the SOC 2 evidence and (2) confirm whether you can accept a BAA / HIPAA scope for a subset of workloads? Our procurement window is tight — aiming to complete vendor review by Aug 6.

Alex Johnson

Team — forwarding FinCo's questionnaire and Alex's asks. TL;DR: they want SOC 2 Type II evidence (or roadmap), GDPR data residency detail, and confirmation on BAA/HIPAA capabilities. Procurement target: complete vendor review by 2026-08-06.

Proposed plan / owners:
- Rishi: own completion of FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx. Please mark any items that require legal/security policy changes as "needs review". Target: initial draft back to Alex by EOD 2026-07-23.
- Monica: pull the SOC 2 artifacts and a short control matrix. Share SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf link and note scope (currently infrastructure + core platform, not customer-configured pipelines). Also outline ISO 27001 roadmap (expected Q4 2027 assessment) and FedRAMP interest/notes.
- Lauren: coordinate procurement timeline and follow-up call scheduling (Aug 2 preferred).

Notes on HIPAA/BAA: We currently support HIPAA-relevant controls and have customers with BAA in place, but full platform acceptance of ePHI requires Private deployment and specific contractual controls. Monica — please confirm exact language we can provide for procurement.

Let me know if timeline is achievable. I'll own the external communication and share links once Rishi/Monica upload docs.

Thanks,

Marissa / team — initial pass completed on FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx. Key highlights below and attached the completed workbook.

Highlights / answers:
- SOC 2: We attached SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf link and noted scope in the workbook (control coverage: infrastructure, model serving runtime, and platform control plane; excludes customer-managed private networks unless requested).
- GDPR: Data residency options documented — hosted regions in US/EU, customers can request EU-only processing. We flagged items related to subprocessor lists and DPA clauses for legal.
- HIPAA / BAA: We can enter into a BAA for Private deployments and dedicated instances; noted the controls required (encryption at rest/in transit, access logging, audit retention) and recommended route for FinCo if they need ePHI handling.
- ISO/FedRAMP roadmap: Short note added: ISO 27001 assessment planned (Q4 2027), SOC scope expansion (evaluating app-layer controls for 2027), FedRAMP: exploratory conversations only.

Next actions:
- Monica: please confirm SOC2 PDF link and provide any red-team / penetration test summary we can attach.
- Marissa / Lauren: I recommend a 30-min follow-up call with FinCo to walk through the questionnaire responses and confirm BAA path.

Deliverables attached: FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire-completed.xlsx (attachment), link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-2025
